title: project bootstrap installer preflight against hosted payload metadata

criteria: Hosted health, descriptor, channel, install bootstrap, payload index, payload manifest, checksums, signatures, and support metadata are fetched with curl --resolve.
Preflight follows RC6 verification order and produces a local report.
Preflight state is verification-blocked for missing signature/signed metadata, revocation snapshot, installer compatibility contract, and rollback baseline.
No install, activation, rollback, active slot mutation, production ring mutation, support upload, remote dispatch, signing, or TUI authority is performed.
